name: claude-x
description: Erick Fuga's Claude Code mods: a vim-style status bar, colors for the draft, a vim command line, the draft's attachments as chips, the repository's GitHub issues found with @#, and the spinner without its whimsical word.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A vim-style status bar in the footer: editor mode, permission mode, model, effort, git state, usage and cursor. Numbers the draft's lines and keeps the prompt box taller (minLines, /expand).

plugins.name: syntax
plugins.description: Colors the prompt's draft as it is typed: its markdown, the code in its fences, and in shell mode the command.

plugins.name: vim
plugins.description: A vim command line: :w and :e keep a draft per session, :q quits, any other name runs that slash command, with Tab completion. Drawn in the statusline mod's bar.

plugins.name: attachments
plugins.description: The draft's attachments as chips above the prompt: each pasted picture, pasted text, @-mentioned file or folder and, with the issues mod, @# issue, with a glyph for its type, its path and what it is, and a × to take it out of the draft.

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: Finds the repository's GitHub issues as @# is typed: a list above the prompt filtered by number or title, picked with a click or Ctrl+X Tab, and each @#N sent with the issue for the model to read.

plugins.name: stfu
plugins.description: Takes the whimsical word out of the line drawn while Claude works and out of the one that closes a turn, keeping the elapsed time, tokens and thinking where Claude Code draws them.
